units.title: Present time
units.core: simple present (form, spelling of -s/-es, questions/negatives), present progressive, present perfect; stative verbs; frequency adverbs
units.extend: present perfect progressive; time words for each present form; perfect vs perfect progressive

units.title: Past time
units.core: simple past (regular/irregular), past progressive, past perfect; *used to*
units.extend: past perfect progressive; *would* for past habits; time words for past forms

units.title: Future time
units.core: *will*, *be going to*, present progressive and simple present for future
units.extend: future progressive, future perfect (progressive); time clauses (no *will* after *when/before*)

units.title: Time shifts in writing
units.core: choosing tenses; time words that signal a shift
units.extend: shifting consistently across a paragraph; background vs main events

units.title: Subject–verb agreement
units.extend: collective nouns, *either/neither*, gerund subjects, long subjects with clauses

units.title: Modals
units.core: *can, could, should, must, may, might*; phrasal modals (*have to, be able to*)
units.extend: past modals (*should have*, *might have*); degrees of certainty; modals in academic hedging

units.title: The passive voice
units.core: form across tenses; when to use it
units.extend: passive with modals; *by*-phrase choice; passive in reports and process descriptions

units.title: Verb forms, gerunds and infinitives
units.extend: verb + object + infinitive; change of meaning (*stop, remember, try*); *used to / be used to*

units.title: Count and uncountable nouns
units.extend: units of measure; nouns that are both; academic uncountables (*research, evidence, advice*)

units.title: Articles and other determiners
units.extend: generic reference; *the* with superlatives/unique nouns; quantifiers with *of*

units.title: Pronouns
units.extend: agreement with indefinite pronouns; avoiding vague *this/it*

units.title: Sentence structure and punctuation
units.core: clauses; fragments, run-ons, comma splices; basic commas, full stops, capitals

units.title: Adjective (relative) clauses
units.extend: defining vs non-defining; reduced relative clauses; prepositions + *which/whom*

units.title: Adverb clauses
units.extend: reduced adverb clauses; choosing subordinators for cohesion

units.title: Word forms
units.extend: comparatives and superlatives; word-form choice in academic phrases

units.title: Prepositions
units.extend: dependent prepositions (adj/verb/noun + prep); prepositional phrases in academic writing
